tools.name: acceptance_gate
tools.description: Close a task against an acceptance contract and return a CompletionReceipt. Call once per deliverable and then answer from the receipt; do not re-run the gate on its own receipt. Send one flat object: contract fields plus the independent verifier's per-criterion results and artifact checks. Put the exact criterion text in each result. A passed result needs non-empty evidence. The verifier must differ from the executor; `independent` needs a `verifier:` or `agent:` id, `human` needs `human:`. Read-only: it does not run the task or a checker. Only an `accepted` receipt justifies `completed`.

acceptance_criteria.description: Public criteria. Each text must appear exactly once in `results`.

artifact_checks.description: Exactly one check per expected artifact.

executor.description: Identity that did the work, e.g. `model:worker`.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256; omit this field to require only one passing check.

hidden_criteria.description: Checks the executor did not see. Any failure makes the decision `hacked`.

residual_risks.description: Known open risks. Any `high` impact turns `accepted` into `conditional`.

criterion.description: Exact text of one acceptance or hidden criterion.

task_id.description: Stable id for this task or deliverable.

verifier.description: Independent verifier identity; must differ from `executor`.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Computer-use browser sandbox. Supports open/navigate/read/click/type/press/screenshot/audit/close. `audit` returns real viewport metrics (scrollWidth/clientWidth, placeholder hits, tap-target sizes) and PNG paths for local design review; use it with `allow_loopback=true` on a preview_file URL and no network permission. Every http(s) host, including subresources, must be explicitly allowlisted; loopback requires allow_loopback. The browser cannot run in read-only mode. Buttons, submits, cross-origin links, password entry and Enter create a persistent action card: ask the human to run `1agent browser approve <card_id>`, then retry with approval_id. After `approval_required`, keep the current browser session: do not call open or navigate again, because a reload invalidates the DOM-bound card; retry the exact same selector/action with approval_id. Cards last 10 minutes; if expired, regenerate. Password fields require secret_ref, never plaintext.

tools.name: clarify
tools.description: Ask the user a blocking structured clarification (1-5 questions, 2-4 options each, an automatic Other and at most one recommended option). Use only when the answer cannot be inferred from the conversation, the journal or memory. Set `requires_text: true` on any option that asks the user to supply a name, copy, URL, number or other concrete input; selecting it then requires text and an empty promise is not an answer. Options must be answerable by the human; never offer an option that promises the agent will grant itself a permission or perform an action it cannot do. Returns answered/skipped/unanswered questions and keeps the default answer valid.

blocking.description: At least one question must be blocking

requires_text.description: Selecting this option opens a text field; empty text is not an answer.

tools.name: describe_self
tools.description: Return live facts about this agent: registered tools and their parameters, permissions, risk, the selected provider/model and the run budgets. Use this for questions about what you can do; never answer from a memorized list.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace text in an existing UTF-8 file inside an allowed root. old_string must occur exactly once unless replace_all=true. The whole updated file is written atomically; the observation includes SHA-256 before and after. Requires write permission.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the process cwd.

tools.name: preview_file
tools.description: Serve a local HTML file or directory on 127.0.0.1 and verify it with an HTTP 200 fetch. Use after writing a page so the user can click a URL; the server lives while this 1Agent process runs. Read-only; the path must be inside a read root.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a local document inside an allowed read root. Supports text/code/markup, HTML/XML, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ODT/ODS/ODP, EPUB, RTF, CSV/TSV, EML, IPYNB, image OCR (tesseract), legacy DOC/XLS/PPT (catdoc/xls2csv/catppt), and archive entry listings. Read-only; missing converters fail with an install hint.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed read root.

tools.name: request_tools
tools.description: Ask the runtime to add tools that are not currently offered. The runtime checks permissions and makes the requested schemas available on the next step. Use this when the task needs a capability you do not currently have.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search UTF-8 text files under an allowed read root, skipping symlinks and generated directories. An empty query lists file paths instead of searching contents.

tools.name: skill_list
tools.description: List registered skills with name, version, status and risk.

tools.name: skill_search
tools.description: Search installed skills (the 1Agent skill journal and user SKILL.md roots) by name, description or body. Returns skill metadata, path and a bounded body so the planner can assign the skill to a Worker. Read-only; it never activates or executes a skill.

tools.name: terminal_create
tools.description: Create a persistent terminal (PTY) session through Skynet Workshop. Returns a session_id. Use terminal_write and terminal_output for interactive programs such as copilot or gh auth login; use terminal_exec for non-interactive commands. Requires write permission.

cwd.description: Working directory. Must be inside an allowed read root.

tools.name: terminal_exec
tools.description: Run a non-interactive shell command in an existing terminal session and return its bounded output and exit code. Create a session with terminal_create first. Use terminal_write and terminal_output for interactive programs such as copilot or gh auth login. Requires write permission.

command.description: Shell command to execute in the session.

tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.description: Verify a local artifact: file exists, size, media type, lightweight schema, SHA-256, and optional loopback preview HTTP 200. Read-only; it does not render, write or install. Use after producing a file and before claiming completion.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a complete UTF-8 file inside an allowed root. The parent directory must already exist. Existing files are refused unless overwrite=true. Writes are atomic; the observation includes the file's SHA-256. Requires write permission.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Default false.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the process cwd.
